style.backgroundSystem: one flat studio field per screen: seamless #FFFFFF for the main image, the silhouette comparison and the size-spec screen, mist-blue #A9C4E0 for the benefit hero and the trust close, soft #D7E5F2 for the scene, material and SKU screens, so no two neighbouring screens share a base field; a circular vignette window and polished sphere props are the only recurring set devices, no scenic depth, no gradient
style.direction: cool blue-grey apparel studio commerce with spherical props and clean infographic bands
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in #1E2A44 inside outlined circles, one icon per row, no filled badges, no 3D icons
style.lightingSystem: cool even studio light around 6000K, large front-left softbox key with a right fill card, gentle wrap on knit, soft contact shadow only under hems and spheres, low specular highlights
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool blue-grey apparel studio visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless studio field #FFFFFF, mist-blue panel #A9C4E0, soft silver-blue field #D7E5F2 and ink-blue text #1E2A44; cool even studio light around 6000K with a large front-left softbox key, right fill card and soft contact shadows only; modern geometric sans-serif as the single type family with copy only inside clean reserved zones; thin single-weight line icons in ink-blue #1E2A44 inside outlined circles; worn screens always framed from the neck down and flat-lay scale never mixed with on-body scale inside one screen; polished sphere props and one circular vignette window as the only recurring set devices; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented fabric percentages or size numbers.
noDrift: no visible model face or identity
no invented fabric percentages, gram weights, size numbers or test data
no floating props without contact shadow
style.presentationRules: worn screens always frame from the neck down so no face is needed; on-body and flat-lay scales never mix inside one screen; the same slight 3/4 torso reading repeats on benefit and SKU screens while the main image stays straight-on
style.surfaceSystem: matte #D7E5F2 studio floor, matte #FFFFFF counter board for flat lay, invisible torso form for worn screens so the garment keeps its own drape
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif as the single family, copy only inside clean reserved zones, Chinese copy rendered as short placeholder lines in 「」, no serif, no handwritten, no retro lettering
